key_impacts: Plants at Fukushima Daiichi were damaged, initiating a long-term decommissioning process.
The site entered an emergency situation after the accident before later stabilization.
Large volumes of contaminated/treatable water accumulated on-site (about 1,100,000 m3 stored as of October 2018).
